title: Global Top Companies by Market Capitalization and Revenue
subtitle: 04/2010 to 09/2026
hook: Watch how the world's most dominant mobile phone brands shifted their market shares over sixteen years.
setup: This data race tracks monthly shifts in global market capitalization and revenue leadership from April 2010 through September 2026.

sequence.text: Nokia starts the timeline strong as the leading entity in April 2010.
Huawei enters the ranking for the first time in March 2012.
Samsung climbs to the top position in June 2013.
Lenovo appears in the rankings as a newcomer in March 2016.
Oppo joins the competition as a newcomer in January 2017.
Vivo enters the top standings with a notable position in November 2020.
Apple recaptures the top ranking in October 2021.
OnePlus appears as a newcomer to the ranking in June 2026.

ending: The long-term race reveals how rapidly industry leaders and challengers trade places in the global market.
